Title: LSJ - Q re Blood of Sandman

Messages.Author: Amenophobis
Messages.Body:
I have question regarding Blood of Sandman:

Blood of Sandman
Action

Thaumaturgy

tha: +1 stealth action. (D) Burn an ally.
THA: +6 stealth action. (D) Put this card on a ready younger tapped
vampire. Reaction cards this vampire plays while tapped are canceled
as they are played. Burn this card if **this** vampire goes to torpor.

In the last sentence, does "this vampire" refer to the acting vampire
playing this card, or to the vampire who gets the card played on? I
must admit, it can be read both ways.

Messages.Author: henrik
Messages.Body:


Most likely it refers to the same "this vampire" as the earlier
sentence about reaction cards.

Messages.Author: Teeka
Messages.Body:


IANLJS, but I'd say that for any card that goes on a vampire, all
further references to "this vampire" mean "the vampire with this
card". See also Archon, for instance.

Messages.Author: Orange Devil
Messages.Body:
While asking about "this vampire" clauses, what about superior
Unburdening the Bestial Soul?

Should the acting vampire burn 2 blood on it's own untap phase to keep
up the card, or on the untap phase of the target vampire?

Unburdening the Bestial Soul
Type: Action
Requires: Obeah/Animalism
[ani] +1 stealth action. Move 1 or more blood from this vampire to any
other vampire.
[obe] As [ani] above, and untap this acting vampire.
[OBE] (D) Put this card on an ally or a younger vampire. The minion
with this card cannot take actions, block or play reaction cards.
During this minion's untap phase, this card is burned unless this
acting vampire burns 2 blood.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

Reaction cards this vampire plays while tapped are canceled as they

are played. Burn this card if this vampire goes to torpor.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"During this minion's untap phase ... unless this acting vampire".
